scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install
scripts.build:proto: npm run build:proto:ts && npm run build:proto:go
scripts.build: npm run prepare && npm run build:proto && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:client:test && npm run lint && npm run test:go && npm run test:integration
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf server/node_modules node_modules
scripts.test:browser:install: puppeteer browsers install chrome && node --input-type=module -e "import {access, constants} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {executablePath} from 'puppeteer'; await access(await executablePath(), constants.X_OK)"
scripts.lint: go vet ./client/... && bash -n scripts/install.sh && bash -n scripts/build-server-bundle.sh
